name: playwright-framework
description: Multi-domain QA automation framework built with Playwright + TypeScript. Demonstrates Page Object Model, custom fixtures, data-driven testing, API testing, multi-environment configuration, Allure reporting and CI/CD on both GitHub Actions and GitLab CI.

scripts.test:ecommerce: cross-env DOMAIN=ecommerce ENV=qa playwright test --project=chromium tests/ecommerce
scripts.test:airline: cross-env DOMAIN=airline ENV=qa playwright test --project=chromium tests/airline
scripts.smoke:qa: cross-env DOMAIN=ecommerce ENV=qa playwright test --grep @smoke --project=chromium ; npm run allure:generate && npm run allure:open
scripts.test:api: cross-env DOMAIN=airline ENV=qa playwright test --project=api tests/api
scripts.lint: eslint pages tests fixtures utils config
scripts.lint:fix: eslint pages tests fixtures utils config --fix

author: Jose Manuel Hernandez @thejmhh
